reason: The construction-plan audit found both plan defects and architecture ambiguities. Architecture authority must be revised and re-locked before A0 can be completed honestly.
authority_decision: current explicit user requirements and production safety

architecture_ambiguities.summary: A10 combines media evidence and owner approval while the ReleaseLedger phase model defines them as separate gates.
The architecture requires artifact drift detection but does not explicitly assign exclusive write ownership of each artifact to one work package.

construction_defects.summary: The inherited controller hard-codes REPAIR_REQUIRED after every nonterminal task instead of preserving architecture phases.
A1/A2 artifact paths overlap with later A tasks, so legitimate downstream edits would invalidate upstream evidence.
Evidence glob A1*.json can also match A10 evidence.
Legacy controllers and root guidance can still select obsolete R/DDO/CPL work.
Claim output serializes the complete workspace manifest and needlessly expands the model context.
A10 manual media and owner gates can be represented only as self-reported check names in the first plan.

required_action: Release the A0 lock through fail, revise the architecture authority, regenerate the construction registry, and rerun A0 from a new claim.
